snippet.title: Mayday: The Survival Island | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Mayday: The Survival Island is Out Now on Steam!
Wash up on the island today ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1686230/Mayday_The_Survival_Island/

Something was on the island long before you crashed into it. Hunt, fish, farm, and craft your way from a first-night shelter to a homestead worth defending, then sail across 24 hand-drawn islands and start unravelling the mystery the island holds by discovering carved symbols, ruins, and totems someone left there on purpose.


Available on the indie.io Store ➤ https://store.indie.io/mayday-the-survival-island 
Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
